wikidot5e:wondrous-items:topaz-annihilat.effectSummary: Legendary two-handed firearm, range 100/300, requiring no ammunition and dealing 2d6 necrotic on a hit. If its damage reduces a creature or object to 0 HP, the target turns to dust; a creature destroyed this way can return only by true resurrection or wish. Once per dawn while it is on your person, use an action to cast disintegrate at save DC 18.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:two-birds-sling.effectSummary: This +1 magic sling can ricochet. When a ranged attack with it hits, you may make another ranged attack with the same ammunition against a second target within 10 feet of the first.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:ventilating-lun.effectSummary: Attuning replaces your lungs with the metallic prostheses; your original lungs reappear if attunement ends. Their basic breathing works even in antimagic and cannot be magically suppressed. Outside antimagic/suppression, breathe normally in any environment including vacuum and gain advantage on saves against harmful gases, inhaled poisons, and gaseous breath weapons. Once per dawn as an action, exhale gust of wind at save DC 15 without components.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:verminshroud.effectSummary: Evolving legendary cloak. Dormant: advantage on smell-based Perception, disease immunity, darkvision 60 feet or +60 to existing darkvision; once per dawn as an action polymorph yourself into giant rat or rat while retaining Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma and cloak properties. Awakened: gain poison resistance; once per dawn cast insect plague at save DC 15 without material components; cloak polymorph may instead become giant wasp. Exalted: gain climbing speed equal to walking; teeth become natural weapons for 1d6 + Strength piercing, usable as bonus action; a creature damaged by the bite makes DC 17 Constitution or poisoned 1 minute, repeating each turn end; cloak polymorph may instead become giant scorpion.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:voidwalker-armo.effectSummary: Once per dawn as a bonus action while wearing the studded leather, create an immune-to-damage-and-conditions translucent projection of yourself in an open space within 30 feet until end of turn; make attacks and cast non-self-range spells as though standing in the projection's space. Curse: attunement makes you unwilling to part with the armor and removing it does not end the curse. After each long rest while cursed, DC 11 Charisma or your soul is pulled into a DM-chosen object on another plane; your body becomes inert, nonaging, and needs no sustenance. Destroying the soul-prison object frees you; otherwise only wish restores your soul.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:vorpal-sword.effectSummary: This +3 magic slashing sword ignores slashing resistance. On an attack-roll 20 against a creature with at least one head, sever one head; it dies if unable to survive the loss. Creatures immune to slashing, without/without need of a head, with legendary actions, or judged too large by the DM are immune to decapitation and instead take +6d8 slashing.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:vox-seeker.effectSummary: Each action spent winding the Tiny automaton lets it operate 1 minute, maximum 10. While operational it is DM-controlled and must move toward and attack the source of the nearest voice within 60 feet, ignoring all other targets. Stat block: AC 14; 7 HP (2d4+2); speed/climb 20; Str 2, Dex 10, Con 12, Int 1, Wis 10, Cha 1; immune poison and psychic damage and blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned; blindsight 60 feet and blind beyond; Spider Climb; Pincer +2 melee, 1d4 piercing +3 lightning. At 0 HP it is destroyed.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:voyager-staff.effectSummary: This +1 magic quarterstaff also grants +1 spell attack while held. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6+4 daily at dawn. As an action cast using your spell save DC: banishment 4, blink 3, misty step 2, passwall 5, teleport 7. If the last charge is spent, roll d20; on 1 it vanishes forever.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:wand-of-binding.effectSummary: Spellcaster wand with 7 charges, regaining 1d6+1 daily at dawn; if the last charge is spent, roll d20 and on 1 it crumbles to ash. As an action cast hold person at save DC 17 for 2 charges or hold monster for 5. While holding it, use your reaction and 1 charge to gain advantage on a save to avoid paralyzed/restrained or on a check to escape a grapple.

wikidot5e:wondrous-items:wand-of-conduct.effectSummary: Has 3 charges, all restored daily at dawn. While holding it, use an action and 1 charge to create orchestral music audible 60 feet for as long as you keep waving the wand. If the last charge is spent, roll d20; on 1 a sad tuba sound plays and the wand crumbles to dust.
